PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES — MOCK EXAM #18
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Free-hand sketching, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Free-hand sketching.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Free-hand sketching.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Free-hand sketching.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Free-hand sketching.

2. When learning Computer Concepts, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Concepts.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Computer Concepts.

   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Concepts.

   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Safety in the Immediate Environment.

4. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Overload every socket
   C. Ignore burnt cables
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

6. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. Monitor
   C. Keyboard
   D. CPU

7. When learning Non- Metallic Materials, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Non- Metallic Materials.

   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Non- Metallic Materials.

   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for ICT Tools in Communication.
   D. Skip safety briefings for ICT Tools in Communication.

10. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   D. Remove all guards

11. When learning Introduction to Pre-Technical Studies, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
